title: Now try it on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have opened apps, moved windows and used the trackpad on a practice machine. Now use yours.
• Open any app on your own computer, then drag its window by the strip along the top.
• Drag a corner to make the window bigger, then use the buttons at its top corner to hide it and bring it back.
• Find the clock, the battery and the WiFi symbol on your own screen. They are usually along one edge.
• Close the app properly rather than leaving it open. A window you closed is a window you understand.
drDigitalSuccess: Every one of those is the same action on your machine as it was on the practice one.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then try each step on your own computer.
